frozen_before: any held-out (test) query was retrieved or judged

protocol.selection_pool: BGE-reranked variants scored on the dev set
selection_rule: 3. among negligible, prefer fewest parameter changes vs current (bm25_w, vec_w, k, ob, C, exp)
4. remaining ties: higher nDCG@5, then MRR, then P@5, then R@5
adoption_rule: dev nDCG@5 gain >= 0.02 vs current config (same dev pool)
held-out P@5 >= current held-out P@5 - 0.025 (one chunk across 8 queries x 5 slots)
protocol.held_out_policy: evaluated exactly once, after freezing the selection

selection_note: w1.5/0.75+noexp was added in dev pass 2 after pass 1 showed BM25-leaning weights and expansion-off each helped; selection stayed dev-only. At k=60 a 2:1 BM25:vector ratio ranks the whole BM25 top-60 above vector rank 1, so the vector arm contributes only via the overlap bonus.
